# Open Student (אופן סטודנט)

> A free mobile app that helps students at the Open University of Israel
> (האוניברסיטה הפתוחה) manage their degree — courses, assignments, exams,
> focus timer and study groups in one place. Hebrew interface, iOS and Android.

Open Student is an independent app. It is **not affiliated with, endorsed by, or
operated by the Open University of Israel**. Course names, course numbers and
academic terms shown in the app are for convenience only; the university's own
systems remain the authoritative source.

## Key facts

- **Name:** אופן סטודנט (Open Student)
- **Price:** free to download and use
- **Platforms:** iOS, Android
- **Language:** Hebrew (he-IL), right-to-left
- **Audience:** students at the Open University of Israel
- **Website:** https://www.openstudent.co.il
- **Contact:** contactdadyapp@gmail.com

## What it does

- **Courses** — track courses by credit points (נ״ז), semester and year, each with a status: in progress, planned, or passed.
- **Assignments** — track ממ״נים (mailed assignments) and ממ״חים (computer-checked assignments) with their due dates, and see which one is due next.
- **Exam countdown** — the next exam and the number of days left until it.
- **Pomodoro timer** — built-in 25-minute focus cycles with breaks.
- **Study groups** — save a WhatsApp group link per course and open the right one in a tap.
- **Degree progress** — grade average and percentage of the degree completed.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.openstudent.co.il/): what the app does, screenshots, and a FAQ.
- [Support](https://www.openstudent.co.il/support): contact form, email, and troubleshooting FAQ.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.openstudent.co.il/privacy): what data is collected and how it is handled. Study content is never sold or shared for advertising.
